prompt: Which statement about Redis Cloud database endpoints is correct?
explanation: Every Redis Cloud database — Essentials and Pro — has a public endpoint reachable from the internet. Redis Cloud Pro databases additionally get a private endpoint, which is usable only after a private connectivity method such as VPC peering, Google Cloud Private Service Connect, or (on AWS) Transit Gateway or PrivateLink is in place.

options.text: Every database has a public endpoint; Pro databases also have a private endpoint that requires a private connectivity method
Every database has a private endpoint; a public endpoint is optional on all plans
Essentials databases have both endpoint types, while Pro databases have only a public endpoint
Public endpoints exist only on Free plans and disappear when the database is upgraded
